About Pizza Time

Made for the craving.

Pizza Time is a local restaurant serving customers around Mirpur, Dhaka. The website keeps the experience simple: browse the menu, choose your item and size, add your delivery details and send the order directly to WhatsApp.

Whether you are ordering a classic pizza, a loaded signature option, pasta, burger, chicken or something on the side, the goal is to make the path from craving to order quick and clear.

How ordering works

From craving to confirmation.

No separate pizza builder is needed here. Size and available options are selected at the moment you add a pizza to your order.

01

Choose your food

Browse the menu and select a pizza, pasta, burger, chicken item or side.

02

Set the order

For pizza, choose 8″, 10″ or 12″. Adjust quantities in your cart and add your delivery details.

03

Share & confirm

Allow live location access, review the order and send the complete request to Pizza Time on WhatsApp.

Questions before ordering

Frequently asked questions.

Where is Pizza Time located?

House 1/C, Road 19, Block B, Section 10, Mirpur, Dhaka 1216, near HOP School.

How do I place an order?

Add your items to the cart, review your quantities and use the WhatsApp checkout button.

How do I choose a pizza size?

Click Choose on a pizza item and select 8″, 10″ or 12″. The corresponding menu price will be added to your cart.

Can I share my live delivery location?

Yes. During checkout, tap Share Live Location and allow browser location permission. A Google Maps link is added to the WhatsApp order.

Can I change the quantity?

Yes. Use the + and − controls in the cart before sending the order.

How can I contact Pizza Time?

Call 01676-290862, email reza84794@gmail.com, or use the Pizza Time Facebook page for updates.
